svg.aria-label: Training-size sweep: accuracies, gaps, and paired gap changes
svg.title: Fixed 65-parameter neural network with 20% independent training-label flips
svg.desc: Thin lines connect individual completed seed sweeps. Thick lines are arithmetic means. Training accuracy uses noisy labels; test accuracy uses clean labels. All size axes are categorical, with equal spacing, not linear sample-size axes. No uncertainty intervals are shown.
svg.text: Training size, noisy-label accuracy, and clean-test accuracy
65 parameters | SGD: 1200 updates per fit | test size: 8192 | completed sweeps: 5/5
Thin lines: paired seeds; thick lines: means. Smaller gaps/changes support a decreasing-gap claim.

svg.text: Adjacent-size changes in both gap conventions
Nested training prefixes; independent flips with probability 0.2; shared test data and initialization within each seed.
Only complete sweeps are plotted. Deadline-interrupted sweeps are discarded; finite seed means do not prove an expectation-level trend.
